name: a desert at dusk seen flat from the side: a sky that goes from day to night, far and near sand dunes with a sharp crest and a shaded lee side, a tall thermometer planted in the sand, and a humid town with a cloud far to the right
fits: anything about a landscape that heats and cools over a day: why a place is cold at night, heat leaving the ground, clouds and water vapour acting as a blanket, day and night temperature swings; the hero is the thermometer in the sand, the camera pans from the dunes to the town and back
recipe: flat 2D side view (no iso): a sky of stacked bands with a night veil and stars, a sun and a moon on arcs, three layers of dunes as smooth crest paths in sand tones each with a darker lee side, a thermometer on a plank, heat arrows rising from the sand, a town of low blocks and a two-tone cloud with vapour dots
